reopening_requirements.cf003: All linked189/61/250 inputs, exact dated biographies and cleaning rules, ten full chart-conditioned word-score/denominator portraits per person, target ranks/ties, fixed predictor vectors and nine success vectors, original30k-shuffle inputs/procedure and pre61 freeze history; clarify22 acquaintances. reopening_requirements.cf004: All141 linked birth/selection/latitude records, both chart versions/settings, original full French profiles and generation/selection provenance, full word-score vectors/denominators, all paired scores/wins/ties and correction provenance for all documented discrepancies and failed latitude analyses. reopening_requirements.null: Freeze defensible assignment strata/covariates, dependence, endpoint family, ties, sparse-stratum rules, seeds/draws and failure handling before new null/assignment-dependent repair. Keep charts and fixed predictors, reassign complete comparable biographies, recompute all affected stages. No finished-target shuffle or assumed50/50 substitute.
reopening_requirements.separate_development_search: 42-to18-to7 and Solver logs needed for a whole-search development null; no refitting inside genuinely frozen61-person testing.

reopening_requirements.activation: Accepted source reproduction and interpretable source-specific reanalysis are not new untouched validation. Preserve independent measurement, exact pre-outcome mapping/protocol and untouched held-out replication requirements.
